ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Innovative Money Matters Private Limited, a promoter of Almondz Global Securities Limited, has disclosed an open market acquisition of 148,414 equity shares on September 25, 2026. This minor acquisition increased their holding by 0.08% to a total of 0.87% of the target company's voting capital (0.80% diluted). While compliant with SEBI regulations, the incremental stake is too small to represent a material impact on ownership structure or signal any red flags beyond standard disclosure.
